I'm excited to share a feature on Seqera's blog about our Nextflow training and capacity-building initiatives here at the University of Vermont.

The article discusses how we're using Nextflow and workflow automation to transform computational biology research, enhance reproducibility, and train the next generation of bioinformaticians in Vermont.

**Read the full article here:** [Teaching, Training, and Transforming: Building Capacity with Nextflow in Vermont](https://seqera.io/blog/teaching-training-and-transforming-building-capacity-with-nextflow-in-vermont/)

This work reflects our commitment to democratizing bioinformatics through open-source tools and collaborative education.
